description: φ-rung ↔ hyperon-onset identification under the Map C power-law q↔ρ map: anchor-independent rung-ratio exponents β (φ) and γ (φ²) relative to the silver anchor; the Λ-onset window 2–3 ρ₀ pins the coral-tube scale to |c_r| ≈ 0.87–1.14 fm (fermi-scale, bracketing 1 fm) and DERIVES silver at ≈ 4.2–9.6 ρ₀ (just above the heaviest known-pulsar central densities — proto-NS / second-burst territory) and φ² at ≈ 4.8–12.2 ρ₀.

exponents.note: ρ_φ = ρ_c^β and ρ_φ² = ρ_c^γ hold for ANY anchor of the power-law map — the identification transfers the hyperon onset into a prediction of the silver and φ² densities with no extra freedom

consistency.corpus_layered_table: conj:color-superconductivity-borromean places the hyperonic layer at ρ₀–2ρ₀ — adjacent to (slightly below) the literature onset; the φ-rung identification sits at the literature window, i.e. the corpus table's upper edge
consistency.nicer_gate: derived silver 4.2–9.6 ρ₀ is ABOVE the inferred central densities of all known pulsars (≤ ~4 ρ₀ at 68%) — no kink in current stars, second burst only in the heaviest proto-NS: consistent with both non-detections

limitations: identification probe: assumes the Map C power-law form and that the φ rung IS the hyperon onset; both are hypotheses, not corpus theorems
Λ-onset window is model-dependent (1.9 ρ₀ to >5 ρ₀ across chiral parameterizations); grid 2.0/2.5/3.0 spans the standard ΛN-only band
